shared_elements: bird or bird-like animal in profile
incised/low-relief carving on a stone surface
justification: The most specific correspondence is the presence of profile bird- or animal-like forms combined with linear, banded carved ornament on stone. The biggest difference is compositional: A is dominated by a few large, relatively isolated relief forms on an architectural wall, while B is a densely filled panel with stacked registers of many small figures and signs.
